title: 第7章 瑶姬：夫君有上卿之才
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“原来如此。”

祁澜顿时明白了杨天佑的意思，看向了杨蛟。

在外人眼中，杨家的门楣，是这一父一子支撑起来的。

杨天佑饱读诗书，行事稳健中正，杨蛟少年英勇，虽然年方十七，但却和祁澜一样，是一名人境巅峰武士，加之天生神力，比祁澜还要强上几分，比如今还只是个浪荡公子哥的杨戬要强不少。

“此事，我会有安排，父亲前些时日允我组建两卒卫队，届时，我可分出两乘甲士，为杨公护卫。”

乘，在这个时代是一个重要的军事编制单位。

一乘，在这个时期是由二十五名战兵组成，以一辆战车为核心，再往上是卒，共百人。

后面到了西周与春秋战国，随着时代发展，一乘又扩大成七十五、一百人等。

万乘之国、千乘之国，指的就是那些军力强大的诸侯国，

他这两乘，按照此时的惯例，必定有两名人境武士在一乘内担任车左、车右，总计四人，再搭配四十八名凡境甲士，配甲持戈，又有军阵配合，血气勾连，不是寻常匪类野人能招惹的。

而杨家兄弟人神混血，天生神力，持械状态下也不是寻常武夫能媲美的，自是可以无视一般的威胁。

到时候再插上代表他们长溪邦国的旗帜，那么其他的邦国，也基本不敢明着对他们出手。

如果有，那他们长溪部就可以名正言顺地出兵攻打，其他人也不会管，因为他们师出有名。

别人最多来劝，来讲和，但不会插手。

至少在这个天下还未大乱，各个邦国之间秩序还在的时候，这么做不会有任何问题。

哪怕距离远打不到，或是对方比自己强，再或者有其他人插手，那也可以请蜀侯鱼凫出面裁定。

他们每年给这位蜀地方伯进贡，可不仅是保护费。

作为蜀地诸侯之长，挑战秩序，就是在挑战鱼凫的权威，不然蜀地一乱，头疼的是蜀侯自己。

“如此，便多谢世子了。”

杨天佑起身长揖，对着祁澜行礼，随后欲言又止。

后者拱手回礼，随后没给杨天佑回话的机会，便将手指向烹着鹿肉的鼎，开口道：

"That's it."

Qi Lan immediately understood what Yang Tianyou meant and looked at Yang Jiao.

In the eyes of outsiders, the lintel of the Yang family is supported by this father and his son.

Yang Tianyou was well-read in poetry and was steady and upright in his actions. Yang Jiao was a brave young man. Although he was only seventeen years old, he was a warrior at the peak of the human realm just like Qi Lan. With his natural supernatural power, he was a bit stronger than Qi Lan and much stronger than Yang Jian, who was just a swinger brother now.

"I will make arrangements for this matter. My father allowed me to form a two-soldier guard a few days ago. At that time, I can detach two soldiers to protect Duke Yang."

Multiplication was an important military establishment unit in this era.

A chariot, at this period, was composed of twenty-five warriors, with a chariot as the core, followed by pawns, a total of one hundred people.

Later, in the Western Zhou Dynasty and the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period, with the development of the times, the number of Yicheng was expanded to 75, 100, etc.

The Kingdom of Ten Thousand Chariots and the Kingdom of Thousand Chariots refer to those vassal states with strong military power.

For his two rides, according to the practice at this time, there must be two human realm warriors serving as the left and right sides of the car in one ride, a total of four people, coupled with forty-eight mortal realm warriors, equipped with armor and holding weapons, and with military formations to cooperate, the blood and spirit are connected, which is not something that ordinary bandit savages can provoke.

As for the Yang brothers, they are of mixed human and divine origin, and have natural supernatural powers. Even when holding weapons, they are not comparable to those of ordinary warriors. They can naturally ignore ordinary threats.

When the time comes to plant the flag representing their Changxi country, other countries will basically not dare to take action against them openly.

If there is, then their Changxi tribe can legitimately send troops to attack, and others will not care, because their divisions are well-known.

Others will at most come to persuade and make peace, but will not interfere.

At least when the world is not in chaos yet and there is still order among the various countries, there will be no problem in doing so.

Even if the distance is too far to hit, or the opponent is stronger than you, or if someone else intervenes, you can still ask Shuhou Yufu to make a decision.

They pay tribute to this local uncle of Shu every year, which is not just protection fee.

As the leader of the princes in Shu, challenging the order is challenging Yufu's authority. Otherwise, if Shu is in chaos, it will be the princes of Shu who have a headache.

"In that case, thank you very much, Your Majesty."

Yang Tianyou stood up, bowed his head, and saluted Qi Lan, then stopped talking.

The latter returned the favor with his hand, and then without giving Yang Tianyou a chance to reply, he pointed his finger at the cauldron where the venison was cooking and said:
